versions.changelog:
alibabacloud-odps-cost-analysis v0.0.1 — Initial Release

- Provides detailed cost analysis for Alibaba Cloud MaxCompute (ODPS) using only 10 approved `aliyun maxcompute` CLI APIs.
- Supports billing summaries, daily trends, storage metrics, compute metrics, and SQL signature analysis.
- Enforces strict constraints: never use non-approved APIs, especially `bssopenapi` or other products.
- Requires minimum Aliyun CLI version 3.3.3, AI-Mode, and specific user agent settings.
- Includes pre-flight checklists and step-by-step workflow for safe, compliant queries.
